up: Retrieve exact IC50 activity values (in nM) for compounds tested against the human protein Cytochrome P450 3A4. Output columns must include: standard_value, molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id, doi, assay_description, assay_chembl_id, target_pref_name, target_organism. Filter activities to standard_type = 'IC50', standard_units = 'nM', and standard_relation = '='. Filter target_dictionary to pref_name = 'Cytochrome P450 3A4' and organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Join activities with assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, compound_records, and docs. Do not apply any row limits. Return all matching rows.
sql: SELECT a.standard_value, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, d.pubmed_id, d.doi, ass.description AS assay_description, ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND td.pref_name = 'Cytochrome P450 3A4' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
